remarks: Why rent when you can own? Affordable ideal starter home or investment property at the well-maintained Prospect Gardens complex. Step inside this light filled ranch style unit featuring a cozy living area with ample space for entertaining with hardwood floors and an eat-in kitchen. As an added bonus, the common charges include heat, hot water and common area maintenance! You'll also benefit from the assigned parking, dedicated storage, and common laundry facilities. Conveniently located near the vibrant SoNo Collection Mall, downtown dining and the Maritime Aquarium. Easy commuter access to I-95, Merritt Parkway, and public transportation. If you're seeking a low-maintenance home or a nice addition to your rental portfolio, this unit is a must-see. Pets allowed!
